notes: version-99.yml carries schema null on purpose: a document declaring a newer format cannot validate against the v1 const, and the expectation is the runner reporting degraded: newer-format rather than a schema pass. One immutable event file per type: the seven ledger ops plus dismiss, archive and mirror. Ids are UUIDv7 and are the file identity; events fold in at order, ties by id. archive is workspace-level and carries no dispatch_id. mirror.yml is also the T1 tracker-mirror fixture: its data is the mirror_data shape {tracker, event_ref, key} and its presence is what makes mirroring idempotent.
